messages:
jamal_release: Heads up — deploybot put promote for release/2026.03.2 on HOLD: artifact indexing timed out during finalization. Anyone digging in?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: indexer finalize timed out while building artifact index for tag release/2026.03.2. Retry scheduled in 5m. Error=504 gateway timeout. Logs: https://deploy.logs/2564321999

maria_dev: Confirming CI uploads: all artifact PUTs returned 200, but registry index ack is missing. uploading node shows: `upload complete -> awaiting index ack`

sre_ash: Indexer had an OOM during compaction earlier, we restarted it. Backlog shows ~12m lag on finalize queue. Investigating memory/cpu pressure.

jamal_release: We can't keep the change window open forever — EMEA folks are waiting. Options: 1) manual finalize ignoring index ack (risky), 2) wait for indexer catch-up, 3) rollback tag and re-run pipeline. Thoughts?

qa_tom: Noticed an unrelated flaky e2e: `auth-session-refresh` failing intermittently. Not blocking this indexer issue but filing a ticket.

maria_dev: @sre_ash can you try scaling indexer or bumping timeouts? Deploybot will auto-retry in 5m but if indexer stays laggy it'll hit the same timeout.

sre_ash: Scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment artifact-indexer --replicas=3` and bumped memory to 4Gi. Rolling restart in progress. Monitoring metrics.

deploy-bot: Retry attempt #2: timed out after 60s on index finalize. Snippet:
```
ERROR IndexerFinalizeTimeout: no ack for 72s
trace: /srv/indexer/finalize.go:117
```

jamal_release: New plan: hold global promotion. We'll pin the registry tag as `staging-promote-locked` to prevent auto-roll; open rollback decision if indexer doesn't recover. @maria_dev prepare rollback/rollback-notes + hotfix branch just in case.

maria_dev: Drafting rollback steps. Proposal: revert tag, re-run CI with `--no-index` flag to bypass indexer for a quick ship, then repair indexer offline and reconcile registry indexes. Writing release notes and rollback doc now.

sre_ash: Indexer compaction is catching up (≈50%). ETA ~8m. If it clears we can run a manual finalize using `--force-ack` from ops. I'll post health when ready.

jamal_release: EMEA change window expires in 45m. If indexer is green in 10m I'm OK with a guarded manual finalize (needs approvals). Otherwise we rollback. @qa_tom hold off on smoke until after promote.

deploy-bot: ManualFinalize is protected: requires two approvals (release-engineer + oncall-sre). Command: `/deploybot finalize --force-ack` (will record approvers).

jamal_release: I can approve. @sre_ash please confirm indexer health=green so ops can run the finalize.

sre_ash: ready — indexer lag 0, compaction complete, memory stable. Logs show successful finalize prep.

jamal_release: Approved. @ops_mina please run `/deploybot finalize --force-ack`.

ops_mina: Running finalize now... Output: `Success: artifact index acknowledged, promotion complete.` Promotion finished: tag `release/2026.03.2` -> promoted :tada: I'll update release notes and unlock changelog.

maria_dev: Re-running post-promote smoke and canary checks now.

qa_tom: Smoke on canary looks good (latency within SLO, no errors). Closing hold.
